Character Introduction Revealed

The makers of the upcoming Tamil action thriller ‘OM – Chapter 1’ have released a special promotional glimpse introducing actor Sai Pallavi as IPS Nithya Reddy. The project is headlined by Dhanush and Malayalam superstar Mammootty, with direction by Rajkumar Periasamy. According to the official announcement, the film is scheduled for a theatrical release on November 20.

In the upcoming feature, Sai Pallavi portrays a former Assistant Superintendent of Andhra Pradesh Police who now serves as an Additional Superintendent at the CBI and is assigned to work alongside Interpol. The newly shared video highlights her character spearheading a mission designated as 'Om', which centers on combatting sandalwood smuggling and safeguarding the environment.

Production and Crew Details

‘OM – Chapter 1’, which also carries the subtitle ‘Udhiram – The Blood Wood’, features Sreeleela in a pivotal role alongside the main cast. The creative and technical crew includes composer Sai Abhyankkar providing the music, Ezhil Arasu K handling cinematography, and R Kalaivanan managing editing duties. Action sequences are choreographed by Yannick Ben and Kecha Khamphakdee.

The feature is jointly produced by Shraddha Agarwal, Dhanush, and Azmat Jagmag under their respective banners, Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios.

Practical Implications and What Readers Can Verify

For moviegoers and industry observers following upcoming releases, the character reveal offers a clearer picture of the narrative direction and scale of ‘OM – Chapter 1’.

  • Confirmed Facts: The film stars Dhanush, Mammootty, Sai Pallavi, and Sreeleela. It is directed by Rajkumar Periasamy, produced under Wunderbar Films and RTake Studios, and has a confirmed theatrical release date of November 20. Sai Pallavi plays CBI officer IPS Nithya Reddy.
  • What Remains Unknown: Plot specifics beyond the core premise involving sandalwood smuggling and the Interpol mission have not been detailed by the producers.
  • Verification: Readers can review the original announcement, character details, and the promotional video directly via [The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/entertainment/movies/om-chapter-1-sai-pallavi-ips-nithya-reddy-mammootty-dhanush-rajkumar-periasamy/article71627698.ece).
